name: White Mountains
description: Named hiking paths in and around the White Mountain National Forest, from OpenStreetMap.
note: OSM trails approximate the AMC White Mountain Guide. The guide's own trail list is copyrighted, so HikeLog does not copy it: this is every named path OpenStreetMap has in the area, which overlaps the guide closely but is not identical (names, splits and a few trails will differ, and it includes some town paths).
